dataset.productVersion: PDS3 dataset V1.0; PDS4 converted bundle label version 1.0
dataset.volumeDescription: PDS Atmospheres mslrem_1001; retrieved MODRDR and matching product labels for selected sols only

measurement.name: Estimated ambient air temperature
measurement.type: In-situ rover-mounted measurement estimate, processed/model-corrected MODRDR

solarLongitude.method: NASA GISS Mars24 algorithm based primarily on Allison and McEwen (2000), with published perturber terms and UTC-to-TT offsets; one Ls is derived at the midpoint of each PDS4 product start_date_time/stop_date_time UTC interval and assigned to its sol rows. REMS counter timestamps are not independently converted to UTC.

qualityControl.productLabelDefinition: Nine characters, byte 0 leftmost: byte 7 = operational-range error below 5 K; byte 8 = observation reliability.
qualityControl.sourceSemantics: PDS code characters represent documented quality factors; 1=good, 0=bad, X=unknown. Context flags are preserved, and are not all treated as air-temperature acceptance gates.
qualityControl.terramatchFilter: Accept only a finite non-sentinel AMBIENT_TEMP value, a nine-character [01X] confidence code, byte 7 equal to 1 (error within operational range, <5 K), and byte 8 equal to 1 (observation reliable). This explicit two-flag rule is a TerraMatch filter, not a PDS-published single quality threshold.
qualityControl.rejectedSamplesAreNot: Rejected records are not interpreted as zero or as evidence of absence.

coverage.sourceCoverageDescription: Focused seasonal sample: one selected sol per 30-degree Ls bin in a central archived Mars year. Bin quantiles describe accepted rows from the selected sol(s), not between-sol or multi-year climate variability; this is not a continuous archive or full climatology.

earthReferenceComparisons.method: Unpaired descriptive distribution juxtaposition; no date alignment and no value subtraction; no suitability inference or ranking.

mars.provider: NASA PDS Atmospheres Node / Curiosity REMS
mars.measurementType: In-situ rover ambient-air-temperature estimate; per-sol mean of QC-filtered MODRDR samples

limitations: REMS is an in-situ estimate from sensors on the rover mast with irregular within-sol session sampling; NASA POWER T2M is a gridded/model-derived daily 2 m product.
The two records cover different periods and are not same-time observations; no numerical delta is calculated.
REMS observed sample extrema are not guaranteed full-sol daily extrema.
The juxtaposition is descriptive context, not analog confirmation or a mission-suitability result.

provenance.provider: NASA Planetary Data System Atmospheres Node
provenance.retrievalMethod: Focused HTTP download of selected per-sol MODRDR ASCII tables and PDS4 XML labels; raw files kept outside repository.

scientificLimitations: REMS MODRDR ambient air temperature is a processed/model-corrected rover-mast estimate, not ground temperature.
PDS says REMS sampling is nominally 1 Hz during sessions, typically five minutes per hour plus additional one-hour sessions; temporal coverage is irregular within a sol.
Observed sample minimum/maximum/range reflect only accepted samples actually present, not necessarily full-sol extrema.
Ls is derived from UTC timestamps with NASA GISS Mars24 equations; it is not supplied as a field in the selected MODRDR table.
NASA POWER T2M is gridded/model-derived at 2 m; Mars REMS and Earth values are not synchronized or measurement-height harmonized.
No humidity comparison is made; measurement definitions are not evaluated in this integration. Pressure is not part of this temperature product and has no matching Earth counterpart here.
No overall score, confidence percentage, ranking, or mission-suitability conclusion is produced.
